newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.44 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.44 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Thursday's tender was 4.44 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compared with the average accepted yield of the previous 28-day bills tender of 4.54 percent on December 3.
Bids for the HK$10 billion issue was barely oversubscribed at HK$11.95 billion and compared to total bids of HK$16 billion for the HK$5.0 billion issue on Tuesday, it said.
The average tender yield was 4.46 percent.

This was the last of three special 28-day issues made to facilitate the implementation of the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system in December 9 and soothe the strong demand from banks for Exchange Fund bills.
Banks, under the new settlement system, can make use of Exchange Fund bills and notes to obtain interest free intraday liquidity by carrying out intraday repurchase transactions with the HKMA.
